scope: train and validation only; test.csv is not opened
note: Shared input splits are preserved without removing or reassigning rows. Normalization decodes serialized string lists and HTML entities, lowercases and collapses whitespace. Within-split equivalents and cross-split overlaps are reported separately. Main metrics use every validation row. Overlap-excluded metrics use the same rows when no overlap is found. This training script never reads test.csv and does not perform an exhaustive cosine-similarity audit. See split_integrity_audit.json for the separate all-split fingerprint audit of this delivered dataset version.
